prompt: Which is the most recent film to dominate the British Academy Film Awards by winning more than seven awards while also having the most total wins and nominations in its award year?
answer: The most recent was **_The Killing Fields_ (1984)**. At the **38th British Academy Film Awards in 1985**, it won **eight awards**—the most of any film that year—from **13 nominations**, also the year’s highest nomination total.
